title: Teenagers
description: TV conversations for internal prototype testing.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 转不过弯的沙发
scenes.english: A sofa that will not turn
quotes: I just don't think it's gonna fit.
我觉得这根本放不进去。
Oh, yeah, it will! Come on. Up, up, up, up, up! Yes! Here we go! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot! Pivot!
能放进去的！来，往上、往上、往上、往上、往上！对了！来吧。转！转！转！转！转！转！
Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!
闭嘴！闭嘴！闭嘴！
Okay. I don't think it's gonna pivot anymore.
好吧，我觉得它转不动了。
You think?
你才发现啊？

scenes.title: 乔伊发现同义词词典
quotes: What... what you working on?
你……你在忙什么？
Oh, Monica and Chandler's recommendation. I want it to sound smart, but I don't know any big words or anything, so...
给莫妮卡和钱德勒写推荐信。我想写得有水平，可我不认识什么高级词汇，所以……
Well, why don't you use your thesaurus?
那你为什么不用同义词词典呢？
What'd I just say?
我刚才说什么来着？
Watch. Here, you, uh, you highlight the word you want to change, go under Tools...
看这里。你选中想改的词，再打开“工具”……
And the thesaurus generates, gives, gives a whole list of choices.
同义词词典就会生成，给出……给出一整列选项。
You can pick the word that sounds smartest.
你可以挑听起来最有学问的那个词。
Oh my God, that's great! I'm smart! No, no, I'm brainy, bright, clever. I love this thing!
天哪，太棒了！我真聪明！不，不，我是才思敏捷、机灵、睿智。我爱这个功能！

scenes.title: 选哪一半芝士蛋糕
scenes.english: Choosing a half of the cheesecake
quotes: All right, pick a half.
好，选一半吧。
Okay, well, this side looks bigger. Uh, there's more crust on this side. Y'know? So, maybe if I measured...
好吧。这边看着大一些。不过这边的饼皮更多。你看？要不我量一下……
Oh, for God's sake, just pick a piece!
天哪，你就随便选一块吧！
All right, pick that.
好吧，我选那块。
That's also the smaller piece.
那块也更小一些。
Okay. There you go. Enjoy your half, my friend, but that is it. No sharing, no switching, and don't come crying to me if you eat your piece too fast.
行，给你。好好享用你那一半吧，朋友。不过说定了，不分着吃、不交换。要是你吃得太快，可别来求我。

scenes.title: 紧张的驾驶课
quotes: This isn't right. God never meant for us to travel at such breakneck speeds.
这不对。上帝可没打算让我们以这么快的速度行驶。
Relax, you're doing great. Ignore the old lady on the Rascal. This isn't a race.
放松，你开得很好。别管那个开代步车的老太太，这又不是比赛。
Dude! A dog!
老兄！有只狗！
Zitch-dog! Yes! One-nothing!
找狗游戏！耶！一比零！
Crap! What do I do? Tell me what to do, Ted!
糟了！我该怎么办？告诉我该怎么办，泰德！
Step on the brake. Sometime in the next twenty minutes.
踩刹车吧。争取在接下来二十分钟内踩下去。

scenes.title: 兔子还是鸭子更合适？
scenes.english: Which animal is the better comparison?
quotes: Relationships are like that. I mean, look, when you first met Don, you hated him. You thought, this guy's a duck. But one of these days, you're gonna realize this is actually someone that I love. He's a rabbit.
关系就是这样。你刚认识唐时很讨厌他，觉得他像只鸭子。但总有一天，你会发现自己喜欢他。他其实是只兔子。
Whoa, I think you got it backwards there, buddy. The duck is the thing you love. The rabbit is the thing you hate.
等等，老兄，你说反了吧。鸭子是你喜欢的，兔子才是你讨厌的。
What?
什么？
Yeah, I gotta agree. Ducks up, rabbits down.
对，我同意。鸭子好，兔子差。
Definitely. Ducks are better than rabbits.
绝对的，鸭子比兔子好。
Hey, I got... ducks are, ducks are... Rabbits are adorable! Ducks are... Have you ever been in a fight with a duck? I mean, ducks are jerks!
鸭子……兔子多可爱啊！鸭子嘛……你们跟鸭子打过架吗？我是说，鸭子可讨厌了！

scenes.title: 退回半张沙发
quotes: It's cut in half.
它被切成两半了。
That's what I'm telling you.
我就是这个意思啊。
Did you cut this couch in half?
是你把沙发切成两半的吗？
This couch is cut in half. I would like to exchange it for one that is not cut in half.
这张沙发被切成两半了。我想换一张没有被切成两半的。
You're telling me this couch was delivered to you like this?
你是说，沙发送来时就是这样？
Look, I'm a reasonable man. I will accept store credit.
听着，我是讲道理的人。给我店铺购物额度也行。
I'll give you store credit in the amount of four dollars.
我可以给你四美元的购物额度。
I will take it.
成交。

scenes.title: 那个吸尘器配件是做什么的？
scenes.english: What is that vacuum attachment for?
quotes: Ta-da!
看！
Are we greeting each other this way now? Because I like that.
咱们现在这样打招呼了吗？我挺喜欢。
Look! I cleaned! I did the windows, I did the floors.
看，我打扫了！我擦了窗户，清了地板。
I even used all those attachments on the vacuum, except for that little round one with the bristles. I don't know what that's for.
我连吸尘器那些配件都用上了，除了那个带刷毛的小圆头。我不知道它是干什么的。
Oh, yeah, nobody knows, and we're not supposed to ask.
哦，没人知道，而且咱们还不能问。

scenes.title: 想象一下不马上付账单
scenes.english: Imagine not paying the bill immediately
quotes: All right, you madcap gal. Try to imagine this. The phone bill arrives, but you don't pay it right away.
好吧，你这位疯丫头。想象一下：电话账单来了，可你没有马上付。
Why not?
为什么不付？
Because you're a kook! Instead, you wait until they send you a notice.
因为你是个怪人啊！你偏要等他们发来催缴通知。
I could do that.
这我能做到。

scenes.title: 一份礼物，还是现在？
quotes: A gift! A present! Present!
礼物！一份礼物！礼物！
Yeah!
对了！
Oh, Leonard. Now, how can you not get that?
哦，莱纳德，你怎么会猜不出来呢？
In what universe is that a present?
在哪个宇宙里，这幅画能叫礼物？
It's not a present. It's the present. Look, there's you and me. There's Penny and Amy. We're playing Pictionary in the present.
不是“一份礼物”，是“现在”。看，这是你和我，这是佩妮和艾米。我们现在正在玩你画我猜。
Oh my God, we're gonna kill them.
天哪，咱们肯定能完胜他们。

scenes.title: 上课得准备笔记本
quotes: All right, let us begin. Where's your notebook?
好，开始吧。你的笔记本呢？
Um, I don't have one.
呃，我没带。
How are you going to take notes without a notebook?
没笔记本你怎么记笔记？
I have to take notes?
我还得记笔记？
How else are you gonna study for the tests?
不然你拿什么复习考试呢？
There's gonna be a test?
还要考试？
Tests. Here. That's college-ruled. I hope that's not too intimidating.
是好几场考试。给你，这是大学生用的横线本，希望不会吓到你。
Thank you.
谢谢。
You're welcome.
不客气。

scenes.title: 字面意思，还是打个比方？
quotes: What's with you?
你怎么了？
You're always correcting people.
你总是纠正别人。
You totally do that! That's absolutely right.
你确实总这样！一点没错。
Right? I never noticed it before, and now it's literally driving me crazy.
对吧？我以前没注意，现在简直要被他逼疯了。
Figuratively.
是“比喻意义上”。
Okay, maybe so, but it's no worse than you using the word literally in every other sentence.
好吧，也许是。但总比你说两句话就用一次“字面意义上”好不到哪儿去。

scenes.title: 那个棕色罐子里装的是什么？
scenes.english: What was in that brown jar?
quotes: Well, you don't look good, Joe.
呃，乔伊，你气色不太好啊。
Well, the fridge broke, so I had to eat everything. Cold cuts, ice cream, limes.
冰箱坏了，所以我只好把里面的东西都吃了。冷切肉、冰淇淋、青柠。
And hey, what was in that brown jar?
对了，那个棕色罐子里装的是什么？
That's still in there?
那东西还在里面？
Not anymore.
现在不在了。

scenes.title: 水原来是这么用的吗？
quotes: You guys, uh, want a drink?
你们，呃，要喝点什么吗？
Uh, I'll just have a water.
呃，我喝水就好。
Mm, technically water is a drink.
嗯，严格来说，水也是饮品。
Really, Professor? You drink it? Is that how water works?
真的吗，教授？水是拿来喝的？原来水是这么用的？
Because I was just gonna smear it on my skin and hope I absorbed it.
我本来还打算把水抹在皮肤上，指望能吸收呢。
Or you could, you know, pour it over your shirt.
或者，你知道，也可以倒在衬衫上。

scenes.title: 我可憋不了两千六百年
scenes.english: Not for two thousand six hundred years
quotes: Oh. Two thousand six hundred years?
哦，两千六百年？
Yeah, give or take. As I was saying, it's a warm summer evening in ancient Greece.
对，大概吧。刚才我讲到，古希腊一个温暖的夏夜。
Yes, Penny?
什么事，佩妮？
I have to go to the bathroom.
我想去洗手间。
Well, can't you hold it?
呃，你不能忍一忍吗？
Not for two thousand six hundred years.
我可憋不了两千六百年。

scene_kNsWCUYPVwU.title: 아슬아슬한 운전 수업

scene_guZULjk7gGk.title: 수업에는 공책이 필요해
